summary: Comoros' NDC blends restoration, conservation, and agriculture, aiming for net sequestration of -1,437 Gg CO2eq by 2035. Restoration targets include 1,200 ha of Eucalyptus planting, 2,200 ha of reforestation (≈1.6% of current forest cover), 8,000 ha of degraded-forest restoration (≈5.9% of forest cover), 6,000 ha of watershed restoration, 1,000 ha of mangroves, 600 ha of coral reefs, a 30–40% erosion cut, and 250,000 tCO2eq/year sequestration. Conservation would expand terrestrial protected areas to 50,500 ha (≈30% of total land area) and raise forest ecological connectivity by 20%. Agriculture would extend agroforestry to 2,300 ha (≈11% of current agricultural area) and increase soil organic matter by 15%. A mixed PES mechanism targets 50,000 beneficiary households.

targets.metric: Reduction of water erosion on sensitive slopes
Payments for ecosystem services and participatory forestry beneficiaries
